notes.title: Amazing Frog Update f0.1.0 The Swindon Town Planning Office
notes.notes:
Its Frog Friday and so we are announcing the next Amazing Frog? Update. (f0.1.0)

http://www.fayju.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/2014-12-12_000241-940x529.jpeg

Welcome to the Swindon Town Planning Office.The Swindon Town Planning Office has recently been opened to allow frogs to explore the plans for the future of Swindon's regeneration Program.  This is the second of Swindon's major town building to be modernized. The foyer has been opened so we can share with you our progress of the expansion of Swindon into Greater SwindonShire and additions and updates That we have been making. Here you can also view the Swindon and Swindon Shire maps and these will be updated as we further the Expansion process.There is a big plan in place for the Amazing Frog? world and since there is just 2 of us building Amazing Frog? and we are always so wrapped up in making new things, we can find it hard to find the time to communicate all new features we are making, or market the game at all, lol.

https://farm8.staticflickr.com/7496/15979041186_419c917dfe_c.jpg

We think its important that you know where you are so check out the miniature maps of Swindon and SwindonShire in the Planning Office for further geographical information

https://farm8.staticflickr.com/7479/15817556290_f2e831a0fe_c.jpg

Check out Out Notice board to find some of the additions to the overall game.

https://farm8.staticflickr.com/7493/16004808015_71dda2e987_c.jpg

Race your frogs around the new Race track outside the WALL. Swindon Ministry of Transportation has been working hard at providing SwindonShire with a good road Network, but as I am sure you are aware civil Engineering takes a lot of Planning, so in the meantime they have laid a race track for you to test out the new Tiny Pooper that is being made in a nearby factory.

https://farm8.staticflickr.com/7473/15819064777_59eff5b8c7_c.jpg


#RIPWheelie touched us all so a new life has been given to the Blue Turbo Mobility scooter… if you can find it.

https://farm9.staticflickr.com/8562/15979037626_d53e913f3f_c.jpg

Zombies can become a pest and so we have improved the Weapon Systems, and Added Lazers and Crossbows to the new system. You can kill them all you like… but it won't stop them being a body slamming you in groups.

notes.title: Amazing Frog? f0.1.0 Update coming Early next week + We Are Loving Your Screenshots
notes.notes:
Incase you missed It Amazing Frog? is Available on Steam Early Access. Get it Here We have submitted two builds already...

We will submit f0.1.0 The Swindon Town Planning Office early next week.

Currently loving the Steam platform and very excited about the update process in Early Access.

https://farm8.staticflickr.com/7562/15927213426_1d62b53d67_c.jpg

Our focus is totally Development, This is Early Access after all, environment we need to be in to build Amazing Frog? . We spend most of our time creating content and gameplay and being that its just the two of us building Amazing Frog?, I  can find it tough getting the time to pull my head away from the code and send out an update on whats going on… the short answer is,  We work full time on this and loads is coming up.

As soon as we launched on Steam Early Access a couple of weeks ago we then headed straight to MCM Comicon the next morning. This was great after post launch doubts and zero sleep, personally I was not in a good place mentally, but seeing people enjoy the new split screen 4 player version of the game at the NEC cheered me up no end.

After Comicon ended we threw ourselves straight back into Development and set about fixing some of the more obvious bugs- like the way the see-saw could catapult you right out of Swindon, if you dared to pick it up along with some other forgotten layering issues. Also we enhanced the gym attendees and zombies a bit, fiddled with split screen cameras and of course added a few items here and there for f0.0.2 

The new update planned for early next week  is f0.1.0 is The Swindon Town Planning Office Update.  Is going to be important in how we update you on the progress of Development of Amazing Frog? its also important for us to update you on the bigger plan of where we are heading which we aim to make a lot clearer in this coming update. This is just the begininng and things are going to get a lot bigger, faster. More on this Monday.

For now, please enjoy some of these wonderfully mad screen shots that players have uploaded to the Steam Community
